name: Studio
insp: film title sequences and photo-led studio sites
rec: The photo-led option: it will carry the real office and team pictures best, in the way clients expect from a modern firm.
desc: Shot like a film. Letterbox bars slide open on the real office photos and the headline rises line by line; scroll and the slideshow zooms out into a framed card beside the firm's own words. The services play as a pinned scene, the five promises as letterboxed title cards, and the team rolls past as film credits.
fx: Title sequence: letterbox bars slide open and the headline rises line by line
Office photos crossfade with a thin progress line, and a cursor that reads Play or Pause
Scroll zooms the slideshow out into a framed card as chapter one comes in
Services pin while each photo wipes in and the copy slides from the side
The five promises as letterboxed full-screen title cards
The team rolls past as film credits; the award photo opens through a shutter
